SQLite.name: SQLite
SQLite.doc:
Synchronous SQLite database connection. `SQLite.open()` returns a connection
or nil plus a structured error. `query()` and `execute()` pass the SQL statement
unchanged to SQLite's prepared-statement API and bind positional ? parameters.
Successful results contain rows, columns, affectedRows, and lastInsertId.
Errors contain driver, code, message, and sqlState when available.

methods.name: close
methods.doc: Close this connection. Connections are also closed during garbage collection.

returns.doc: True when an open connection was closed.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.doc: Return whether this connection has not been closed.

methods.name: query
methods.doc:
Execute one SQL statement. The statement is passed unchanged to SQLite and
positional ? markers are bound to the remaining arguments. Lua nil binds SQL
NULL; SQL NULL is returned as nil, so use the columns array when column
presence must be distinguished from a missing row key.

params.name: parameters
params.doc: Positional nil, boolean, number, or string values.

returns.doc: Result and nil, or nil and an error table.

methods.name: execute
methods.doc: Executes a statement intended for commands which do not return rows. Uses the parameter and result contract of `query`.

returns.doc: Result and nil, or nil and an error table.

methods.name: open
methods.doc:
Open an SQLite database under the server's data/internal directory. The
database option must be relative and cannot contain parent traversal. Use
:memory: for an in-memory database. Missing parent directories are created
when create is enabled. Foreign-key enforcement is enabled by default.

returns.doc: Connection and nil, or nil and an error table.

Sprite.name: Sprite

fields.name: position

Vob.name: Vob
Vob.doc: This class represents a 3d object in the world.

fields.name: objectName
fields.doc: Represents the internal engine object name of the Vob.

fields.name: worldTransform
fields.doc: A copy of the Vob world transform. Assign the changed matrix back to update the Vob.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Represents the reference to the parent Vob.

fields.name: cdDynamic
fields.doc: Represents the state of dynamic collision of the Vob. Enabling this option will prevent other dynamic objects from passing through it.

fields.name: cdStatic
fields.doc:
Represents the state of static collision of the Vob. Enabling this option will prevent static objects (i.e. world mesh) from passing
through it.

fields.doc: Represents the max distance at which the Vob will still be rendered.

fields.name: visual

fields.doc: Visual opacity from 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (opaque).

methods.doc: Creates a new Vob using the provided visual model.

methods.doc: Applies a world-transform snapshot to this Vob.

methods.doc: Returns a copy of the world transform. Modify the copy and assign it back using `setWorldTransform` to apply changes.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.doc: This method will set the position of the Vob in the world.

methods.name: getPosition

methods.doc: This method will add the vob to the currently loaded world. If the vob is not added, it won't show up.

params.name: parent
params.doc: Optional parent vob to attach to.

methods.name: removeFromWorld
methods.doc: This method will remove the vob from the currently loaded world.

methods.name: floor
methods.doc: This method will try to put the vob on the floor. If the difference between vob position and the floor y position is <= 1000, the method succeeds.

Voice.name: Voice
Voice.doc: This singleton class controls native proximity voice chat for the local client.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.doc: This function checks whether the server offers voice chat.

returns.doc: True when the server has proximity voice chat enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.doc: This function checks whether voice chat is effectively enabled for this client.

returns.doc: True when server, user, and script settings all allow voice chat.

methods.name: setScriptEnabled
methods.doc: This function changes the client-wide script voice chat gate. Enabling it does not override a disabled user setting.

params.name: enabled
params.doc: Whether scripts permit voice chat; all resources share this gate.

returns.doc: The resulting effective voice chat state.

methods.name: getRange
methods.doc: This function returns the effective local proximity voice range.

returns.doc: Voice range in game units, or zero when unavailable.

methods.name: setLocalRangeLimit
methods.doc:
This function limits the local client's proximity voice range. The server's
range remains authoritative, so this setting can only reduce the range.

params.name: range
params.doc: Maximum local voice range in game units.

returns.doc: True when the range was accepted.

methods.name: getOutputVolume
methods.doc: This function returns the script output-volume multiplier.

returns.doc: Multiplier from 0.0 to 1.0, applied after the user's volume setting.

methods.name: setOutputVolume
methods.doc: This function changes the script output-volume multiplier.

params.name: volume
params.doc: Multiplier from 0.0 to 1.0, clamped to that range.

methods.name: getPushToTalkKey
methods.doc: This function returns the active push-to-talk key code.

methods.name: setPushToTalkKey
methods.doc: This function sets the local client's push-to-talk key for this resource.

params.name: key
params.doc: Keyboard key code in the range 1-255.

returns.doc: True when the key was accepted.

methods.name: getInputDevices
methods.doc: This function returns the available microphone device names.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.doc: This function returns the selected microphone name. An empty string means the system default.

methods.name: setInputDevice
methods.doc: This function selects a microphone by name. Pass an empty string to restore the system default.

params.name: device_name
params.doc: Microphone name returned by `getInputDevices`, or an empty string.

returns.doc: True when the device was selected.

methods.name: getOutputDevices
methods.doc: This function returns the available playback device names.

methods.name: getOutputDevice
methods.doc: This function returns the selected playback device name. An empty string means the system default.

methods.name: setOutputDevice
methods.doc: This function selects a playback device by name. Pass an empty string to restore the system default.

params.name: device_name
params.doc: Device name returned by `getOutputDevices`, or an empty string.

returns.doc: True when the device was selected.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.doc: This function returns the local player's current voice channel.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.doc: This function changes the local player's voice channel.

params.name: channel
params.doc: Printable channel name, up to 32 bytes.

returns.doc: True when the channel change was accepted locally and sent when connected.

methods.name: isTransmitting
methods.doc: This function checks whether the local player is currently transmitting voice.

returns.doc: True while voice frames are being captured and sent.

methods.doc: Returns all text lines.

methods.doc: Returns one line by its one-based index.

functions.name: addEvent
functions.doc: Registers a custom event. On the server, the current resource owns it and its handlers.

params.name: allow_remote_trigger
params.doc: Whether peers may send this event; false by default.

functions.name: addEventHandler
functions.doc:
Subscribes to a built-in or custom event. Custom handlers receive (context, ...), including nil arguments.
Server handlers execute in their owning resource's context and are removed when that resource unloads.

params.name: lua_callback
params.doc: Handler; retain the same function for removal.

functions.name: callEvent
functions.doc: Dispatches a local custom event. Handlers receive (context, ...); payload arguments are never interpreted as metadata.

params.name: options
params.doc: Metadata {sourceId = positive integer}; pass nil for no metadata.
Payload arguments, passed unchanged and in order, including nil.

returns.doc: True if dispatched and not cancelled.

functions.name: cancelEvent
functions.doc: Cancels the current cancellable event.

functions.name: isEventCancelled
functions.doc: Checks whether the current event has been cancelled.

functions.name: removeEvent
functions.doc: Removes a custom event and its handlers. On the server, only its owning resource may remove it.

functions.name: removeEventHandler
functions.doc:
Unsubscribes the original callback passed to [addEventHandler](addEventHandler.md).
On the server, a resource may remove only its own subscription.

params.name: lua_callback
params.doc: The same function object used to subscribe.

functions.name: setEventEnabled
functions.doc: Enables or disables dispatch of an event.

functions.name: setEventValue

params.name: y1
params.doc: The position on Y axis of the first point.

functions.doc: This function will convert RGB components to a lowercase hex color string.

functions.doc: This function will split text according to a format string and return the parsed values.

params.doc: Format string where each specifier maps to a value. Supported specifiers: `d` (integer), `f` (number), `s` (string).

functions.name: sha512

params.name: seed
params.doc: Integer seed from 0 to 4294967295. (Optional, defaults to 0.)

returns.doc: Lowercase hexadecimal hash string (16 characters, including leading zeros).

functions.name: xxh128

returns.doc: Lowercase hexadecimal hash string (32 characters, including leading zeros).

functions.name: setTimer
functions.doc:
This function will create a new timer that calls the given function at a fixed interval.

The timer passes any additional arguments to the callback when it executes.
If execute_times is 0 or negative, the timer repeats indefinitely.

params.name: func
params.doc: Callback function executed by the timer.

params.name: execute_times
